name: base-office-forms
description: BASE forms and documents kit hosted on Cloudflare Pages

scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && npm run functions:build
scripts.lint: eslint functions src tests vitest.config.ts vitest.worker.config.mts
scripts.format: prettier --write src functions/api/v2 tests scripts eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest.worker.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc .github schemas
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src functions/api/v2 tests scripts eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest.worker.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc .github schemas
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:schema:remote: wrangler d1 execute base-office-forms-library --remote --command "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('rfi_records','rfi_attachments','rfi_responses')"
scripts.db:schema:preview: wrangler d1 execute base-office-forms-library --remote --command "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('rfi_records','rfi_attachments','rfi_responses')"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run functions:build && npm run security:dependencies && npm run security:secrets
